# Neverlose UI (user-supplied fork)

Source: user-uploaded `Neverlose-UI-main(1).zip`, `Neverlose-UI-main/Source.lua` (upstream GitHub: Mana42138/Neverlose-UI).
R227 modifications: remove unrequested third-party HTTP/RPC and anti-idle behavior; preserve original 2-column layout and fixed section geometry; deterministic left/right section assignment; touch slider hitboxes and touch drag; sidebar scroll; embedded Vortexion adapter support.
